item.text: The edition is internally clear on the basic loop and most card text, but several interactions materially under-specify an executable state machine—especially attack chaining, reaction priority/timing, and how out-of-turn “NÖ!” fits a single `current_player` interface. I’m marking those rather than choosing conventions.

I treated “page” as the PDF/image page number, 1–2. Quotes below are verbatim excerpts from this edition only.

## Atomic rule facts

### Setup

| ID | Page | Direct German quote | Preconditions | Action | Expected result | Status |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| SET-01 | 1 | “Legt alle 4 Exploding Kittens und alle 6 Karten „Entschärfung“ beiseite.” | New game | Remove named cards | Four Exploding Kittens and six Defuse cards are outside the deck | clear |
| SET-02 | 1 | “Mischt die restlichen Karten sorgfältig. Teilt danach an jeden Spieler verdeckt 7 Karten aus.” | SET-01 complete | Shuffle and deal | Each player receives seven hidden cards | clear |
| SET-03 | 1 | “Zusätzlich erhält jeder Spieler eine Karte „Entschärfung“. So starten alle mit 8 Karten auf der Hand.” | Cards dealt | Give one Defuse to each player | Every player starts with eight hidden hand cards, including one Defuse | clear |
| SET-04 | 1 | “Nehmt jetzt von den zur Seite gelegten Exploding Kittens eine Karte weniger als Spieler teilnehmen und mischt sie in den Spielstapel.” | Player count known | Insert Exploding Kittens | Draw pile contains exactly `players − 1` Exploding Kittens | clear |
| SET-05 | 1 | “Legt die übrigen Exploding Kittens in die Schachtel zurück.” | SET-04 complete | Return unused Kittens | Unused Exploding Kittens are out of play | clear |
| SET-06 | 1 | “Mischt zuletzt alle übrigen Karten „Entschärfung“ in den Spielstapel.” | More than two players; initial Defuses distributed | Insert remaining Defuses | All remaining Defuses enter the draw pile | clear |
| SET-07 | 1 | “Mischt nur 2 Karten „Entschärfung“ in den Spielstapel und legt die übrigen in die Schachtel zurück.” | Exactly two players | Apply two-player variant | Only two additional Defuses enter the draw pile; all others are out of play | clear |
| SET-08 | 1 | “Mischt den Spielstapel und legt ihn verdeckt in die Mitte des Tisches.” | Deck assembled | Shuffle and place face down | Draw-pile order is randomized and hidden | not-testable |
| SET-09 | 1 | “Bestimmt einen Startspieler. (Mögliche Kriterien: der beeindruckendste Bart, dominanter Geruch oder die Länge des Blinddarms etc.)” | Game ready | Select starting player | A starting player is chosen; no deterministic selection rule is mandated | not-testable |

### Turn flow and public state

| TURN-02 | 1 | “Wähle eine deiner Handkarten aus, lege sie OFFEN auf den Ablagestapel und befolge ihre Anweisung.” | Player chooses to play | Play a card | Card is public, enters discard pile, and its instruction is resolved | clear |
| TURN-03 | 1 | “Nachdem du die Anweisung der Karte befolgt hast, kannst du weitere Karten spielen, so viele du möchtest.” | A played card has resolved; turn not otherwise ended | Play another card | Active player may play any number of further legal cards | clear |
| TURN-04 | 1 | “Du beendest deinen Zug, indem du die oberste Karte vom Spielstapel ziehst.” | Turn has not been ended by another effect | Draw top card | Drawing ends the current turn, subject to Exploding Kitten resolution | clear |
| TURN-05 | 1 | “Die Partie geht im Uhrzeigersinn weiter.” | A turn ends and no effect changes succession | Advance turn | Next player is the next surviving player clockwise | clear |
| TURN-06 | 1 | “Es gibt keine minimale oder maximale Handkartenzahl.” | Any nonterminal state | Hold cards | No hand-size limit applies | clear |
| TURN-07 | 1 | “Du darfst die Anzahl der übrigen Karten im Spielstapel jederzeit nachzählen.” | Any game state | Count deck | Remaining draw-pile size is public; card identities/order remain hidden | clear |

### Exploding Kitten, elimination, Defuse, terminal result and returns

|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|

| EXP-02 | 2 | “Solltest du keine „Entschärfung“ mehr besitzen, war’s das.” | Exploding Kitten drawn; player has no Defuse | Resolve explosion | Player is eliminated | clear |
| EXP-03 | 2 | “Alle deine restlichen Karten und das Exploding Kitten wandern auf den Ablagestapel.” | Player is eliminated | Discard cards | Eliminated player’s entire hand and the Kitten enter the discard pile | clear |
| DEF-01 | 2 | “Wenn du ein Exploding Kitten ziehst, kannst du eine „Entschärfung“ ausspielen, statt zu sterben.” | Exploding Kitten drawn; player possesses Defuse | Play Defuse | Player survives and is not eliminated | clear |
| DEF-02 | 2 | “Spiele sie einfach aus und lege sie auf den Ablagestapel.” | DEF-01 chosen | Discard Defuse | Used Defuse enters the discard pile | clear |
| DEF-03 | 2 | “Lege danach das Exploding Kitten zurück in den Spielstapel, und zwar geheim an eine Stelle deiner Wahl, ohne die anderen Karten anzusehen oder umzusortieren.” | Defuse resolved | Reinsert Kitten | Kitten is secretly placed at any chosen deck position; other cards cannot be viewed or reordered | not-testable |
| TERM-01 | 1 | “Eine Runde endet, wenn nur noch ein Spieler am Leben ist: der Gewinner.” | Exactly one player remains | End game | State becomes terminal and the sole survivor is winner | clear |
| RET-01 | 1 | “Der Spieler, der nicht explodiert und als Letzter übrig ist, gewinnt.” | Terminal state | Determine outcome | Winner/loser identity is defined, but no numeric `returns` scale is prescribed | ambiguous |

Du müsstest schon zweimal „Hops!“ ausspielen, um beide Züge zu beenden.” | Player owes two turns from Angriff | Play Hops! | Exactly one owed turn is consumed; two Hops! cards consume both | clear |
| FAV-01 | 2 | “Zwinge einen Mitspieler deiner Wahl, dir eine Karte zu geben. Dieser Spieler entscheidet, welche Karte du bekommst.” | Wunsch is legally playable | Choose another player | Chosen player selects and transfers one card | clear |
| SHUF-01 | 2 | “Misch den Spielstapel sorgfältig neu.” | Mischen is legally playable | Play Mischen | Draw pile is randomized | not-testable |
| FUT-01 | 2 | “Schau dir die obersten drei Karten des Spielstapels an und lege sie zurück, ohne deren Reihenfolge zu verändern.” | At least three cards are available | Play Blick in die Zukunft | Acting player privately sees top three; their order is unchanged | not-testable |
| FUT-02 | 2 | “Zeige diese Karten bloß nicht deinen Mitspielern.” | FUT-01 resolved | Keep information secret | Other players do not learn the viewed identities | not-testable |
| NOPE-01 | 2 | “Mit NÖ! setzt du eine andere Karte und deren Aktion außer Kraft, ausgenommen Exploding Kittens und Entschärfung.” | A cancellable card/effect has been played | Play NÖ! | Target card and action are cancelled; Exploding Kitten and Defuse cannot be cancelled | clear |
| NOPE-02 | 2 | “Es ist so, als würde sich die Karte, das Pärchen oder die Kombination durch ein NÖ! in Luft auflösen.” | Card, pair, or combination is pending | Play NÖ! | Entire pending play has no game effect | clear |
| NOPE-03 | 2 | “Du kannst ein NÖ! auf ein anderes NÖ! legen, um es aufzuheben und daraus ein DOCH! zu machen.” | A NÖ! is pending | Play another NÖ! | Previous cancellation is itself cancelled, restoring the preceding play | clear |
| NOPE-04 | 2 | “Du kannst ein NÖ! auch spielen, wenn du nicht an der Reihe bist.” | Another player is acting | Play NÖ! out of turn | Non-current player may react | ambiguous |
| NOPE-05 | 2 | “Alle Karten, die ge-NÖ!-t wurden, sind raus und bleiben auf dem Ablagestapel.” | NÖ! chain resolves | Finish reaction | Cancelled cards remain in discard pile | clear |

| ID | Page | Direct German quote | Preconditions | Action | Expected result | Status |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| CAT-01 | 2 | “Einzeln sind diese Karten machtlos” | Player has one Katzen-Karte | Play singly | A single Cat card has no individual instruction/effect | clear |
| PAIR-01 | 2 | “Jetzt können ALLE gleichen Karten als Pärchen gespielt werden, um einem Mitspieler eine zufällige Karte zu stehlen.” | Two cards with identical title | Play as pair; choose player | One random card is transferred from chosen player | not-testable |
| PAIR-02 | 2 | “Die Regel gilt also nicht mehr nur für Katzen-Karten, sondern für alle Karten mit dem gleichen Titel” | Two same-title cards of any type | Form pair | Pair eligibility depends on identical title, not card category | clear |
| TRI-01 | 2 | “Wie ein Pärchen, außer dass du dir eine Karte von dem Mitspieler wünschen darfst.” | Three cards with identical title | Play triple; name desired card | Chosen player must give that named card if possessed | clear |
| TRI-02 | 2 | “Hat er keine solche Karte, hast du Pech gehabt.” | Triple target lacks named card | Resolve triple | No card is transferred | clear |
| FIVE-01 | 2 | “Wenn du 5 verschiedene Karten (jede mit einem anderen Titel) spielst, darfst du dir eine beliebige Karte aus dem Ablagestapel nehmen.” | Five cards with mutually different titles | Play five-card combination | Acting player takes one chosen discard card | clear |

## Material ambiguities requiring a decision

1. **Attack chaining (`ATK-02`):** Does an Angriff played during the first of two owed turns replace the complete remaining obligation with two turns for the next player, or transfer/add outstanding turns? The text says only that the next player “muss zwei Spielzüge ausführen.”

2. **When Angriff may be played during the two-turn obligation:** Does “dabei” cover either owed turn, and does the result differ on the first versus second?

3. **NÖ! reaction window:** At precisely what point is an action resolved and therefore too late to cancel?

4. **NÖ! priority:** When several non-current players can react, who gets the first opportunity, and in what order may they add NÖ! cards?

5. **Closing a NÖ! chain:** The rules provide no pass/priority procedure determining when the chain is final.

6. **`current_player` during reactions:** An out-of-turn NÖ! is legal, but the edition does not say whether the reacting player temporarily becomes current, whether reactions are separate legal actions, or whether the engine must solicit reactions.

7. **Target with no cards:** Wunsch and random pair theft do not specify what happens when the selected player has an empty hand or whether such a player is a legal target.

8. **Small draw pile for Blick in die Zukunft:** The card says to inspect three cards but does not specify behavior when fewer than three remain.

9. **Taking NÖ!-cancelled cards with a five-card combination:** Cancelled cards remain in the discard pile, while the five-card combination permits “eine beliebige Karte”; the edition does not explicitly exclude those cards.

10. **Five-card discard timing:** It is unclear whether the five component cards enter the discard pile before the selected discard card is chosen and can therefore themselves be selected.

11. **Numeric returns:** The unique winner is defined, but no numeric winner/loser values, zero-sum convention, or handling of earlier elimination order is specified.

## Black-box scenario candidates

All candidates assume states arise through ordinary public actions. No hand/deck injection or private-state mutation is assumed.

| Candidate | Public precondition and action | Public expectation | Reachability/observability |
|---|---|---|---|
| BB-01 Normal draw | Nonterminal state; record `current_player`; invoke normalized `draw` action | If no explosion occurs, `terminal == false` and `current_player` advances clockwise | Reachable, but the non-explosion branch is chance-dependent |
| BB-02 Hops! | Current player has a legal action normalized as `hops`/`skip` | Action ends turn without an additional draw action; `current_player` advances | Conditionally deterministic once the action is naturally legal |
| BB-03 Angriff | Current player has legal `angriff`/`attack` | `current_player` becomes the next player; attacker does not perform a draw action | Conditionally deterministic |
| BB-04 Two-turn Angriff obligation | After `attack`, victim naturally has two legal `skip` actions available | First `skip` leaves the same victim as `current_player`; second advances to the following player | Deterministic but difficult to reach without favorable hands |
| BB-05 Angriff transfer | Attacked player plays legal `attack` during the obligation | Following player becomes `current_player` and receives a two-turn obligation | Materially ambiguous for accumulated/remaining obligations; test only after policy approval |
| BB-06 NÖ! cancellation | A cancellable named action is pending and another player has legal normalized `nö`/`nope` | Cancelled action produces no transition effect; original active player remains responsible for continuing/ending the turn | Public API may not expose reaction windows; ambiguous |
| BB-07 NÖ! on NÖ! | Pending action receives `nope`, then a second legal `nope` | Original action becomes effective again | Requires ordered out-of-turn reactions unsupported by a simple single-player action API |
| BB-08 Explosion terminal branch | In a two-player game, a draw publicly reveals an Exploding Kitten and drawer cannot Defuse | `terminal == true`; sole survivor is winner | Trigger cannot be deterministically reached without deck control; numeric `returns` cannot be asserted |
| BB-09 Defuse branch | Draw reveals Exploding Kitten and normalized `entschärfung`/`defuse` is legal | After Defuse/reinsertion, `terminal == false`; turn passes to the next player | Chance-dependent reachability; secret reinsertion position cannot be verified |
| BB-10 Combination legality | At a naturally reached state, compare normalized legal-action names/count | Same-title pair/triple or five-distinct-title combination appears as a legal action; after play, component card instructions do not execute | Exact hands are private and not deterministically reachable; action-name normalization must encode components/target |

The strongest practical public checks are BB-01 through BB-04. BB-05 through BB-10 are valuable fidelity cases, but require either an approved ambiguity policy, unusually favorable natural trajectories, or an interface that explicitly represents reaction and combination actions.
